UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated player profile and online career statistics.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

OnlineRoom.title: OnlineRoom
OnlineRoom.description: Real-time private multiplayer chess room with synchronized FEN, move history, timers, and turn enforcement.

creatorColor.description: Piece color chosen by the room creator.

whitePlayerId.description: UID of White player, or empty string if waiting.

blackPlayerId.description: UID of Black player, or empty string if waiting.

whitePhotoUrl.description: Photo URL of White player or empty string.

blackPhotoUrl.description: Photo URL of Black player or empty string.

participantIds.description: List of 1 or 2 participant UIDs in the room.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the room.

fen.description: Authoritative Forsyth-Edwards Notation of the current board position.

turn.description: Color whose turn it is to move.

moveCount.description: Total half-moves played in the game.

lastMoveUci.description: Last move in UCI notation (e.g. e2e4).

lastMoveSan.description: Last move in SAN notation (e.g. Nf3).

uciHistory.description: Bounded list of UCI moves played.

sanHistory.description: Bounded list of SAN moves played.

timerMinutes.description: Initial clock duration per player in minutes (1, 3, 5, 10, 15).

whiteTimeMs.description: Remaining White clock time in milliseconds.

blackTimeMs.description: Remaining Black clock time in milliseconds.

winner.description: Game winner or DRAW when finished.

termination.description: Reason the game ended (CHECKMATE, STALEMATE, RESIGNATION, TIMEOUT, DRAW_AGREEMENT, etc.).

drawOfferBy.description: Color currently offering a draw, or empty string.

rematchRoomCode.description: Room code for an agreed rematch, or empty string.

whiteLastSeenMs.description: Client heartbeat epoch millis for White connection status.

blackLastSeenMs.description: Client heartbeat epoch millis for Black connection status.

expiresAtMs.description: Epoch millis after which an unjoined room is considered expired.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user private profile and online chess career statistics.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Real-time private multiplayer chess game rooms keyed by room code.
